answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to post a refundable stake that is slashed if two identities share the same proof-of-work history. A shared reputation atlas records every agent's verified deeds, so a new identity starts with zero trust and must earn it slowly, while a copied sonnet of credentials earns nothing without fresh, costly attestations. Around this, a reef of mutual audits lets established agents challenge suspicious newcomers, forcing an attacker to pay the stake and the audit cost for every fake identity, making mass forgery unprofitable.
